clock_assumption: User accepts accurate HOBO/GPS synchronization; additional offset is zero. This is an assumption, not independent verification.
restart_selection: lowest final negative training marginal log likelihood; no test-label selection
interval: 95% marginal predictive interval for noisy observations (includes learned likelihood noise)
scope: One run, two fixed splits, exploratory validation. No GRG/policy comparison or navigation. No dense-field ground truth or independent daily replication.
